tool.name: Joint binary-signature benchmark calibration
tool.abstraction: Represent one simultaneously selected family of normalized binary decisions by the joint signatures it induces on a frozen witness universe; use injectivity to audit whether the family restores global consistency, then measure the representation capacity separately.
preconditions: the benchmark admits a proved normalization to shared complementary binary cuts
the witness obligations are exactly pairwise separation of a frozen finite generator set
every selected pair contributes one globally shared binary coordinate
tool.operation: map selected normalized cuts to joint witness signatures; prove the coverage/injectivity equivalence; run exact small-world counterexample search; compare minimum code length with the known benchmark and immediately audit the 2^k capacity ceiling
guaranteed_effects: within the registered normalized G_NEQ scope, determines exactly whether a cut family covers all unequal-edge semi-filters
within that scope, constructs an optimal family of ceil(log2 N) cuts and rejects every smaller family
separates benchmark repair from capacity-only route sufficiency
non_guarantees: does not normalize arbitrary full semi-filter cover pairs to complementary cuts
does not bound realizability-sensitive signature systems on other graphs
does not evaluate higher-order tuple, intersection, or closure signatures
does not provide a super-logarithmic lower bound, novelty certificate, or P-versus-NP result
validation_obligations: prove the target-specific normalization before reuse
bind the witness universe and coverage/signature equivalence before counting states
run direct-versus-signature exact regression on small worlds
audit capacity and transport limits separately from calibration success
